title: Negro Leagues Baseball Museum

services.name: Purchase Tickets
services.desc: Purchase your tickets for the Negro Leagues Baseball Museum Tour. Please present this ticket at the main door when you arrive for admission. Maximum of eight (8) tickets per order. A ticket is valid for up to 30 days from the time of purchase. Please Note: Admission Tickets for the Negro Leagues Baseball Museum do not include admission to the American Jazz Museum which is housed in the same building. Due to new 18th Street Pedestrian Mall Construction outside of the main entrance to the Negro Leagues Baseball Museum, please be advised vehicles may park at the Southwest corner of 18th & Paseo Parking Lot. Also, additional free parking can be located in the behind the museum. All museum
